text.description_html:
First Impressions FII-SD-RBAE-14/8 Clear Acrylic Shower Door Pulls with Beveled Ends

**CUSTOM ITEM - NOT RETURNABLE**

Made in the USA by the master craftsmen at First Impressions from the finest clear acrylic available. The acrylic is manufactured with UV inhibitors to prevent yellowing and fading. These are great pulls for glass shower doors.

Specifications for First Impressions FII-SD-RBAC-14/8 Acrylic Shower Door Pull

  • Pull Handle Length: 14"
  • Center to Center measurement: 8"
  • Pull Handle Diameter: 1"
  • Total Projection: 2-3/4"
  • 45 Degree Angle Cut Ends
  • Pull Handle Material: Clear Acrylic
  • Pull Bracket Material: Solid Brass
  • Bracket Finish: Brushed Nickel

Packaged with 2 door pull handles and includes the hardware for back to back mounting on 1/4" to 1/2" thick glass shower doors.

*Sold as a Pair (2 Pulls)

**Made to Order, CUSTOM ITEM - NOT RETURNABLE**
Please allow 4 weeks to ship.
